title: Auto-derive network worker path maps from library roots
summary: Implement C1 from the network worker hardening plan by exposing coordinator library roots and letting workers build an automatic source path map by matching library IDs.
reason: Every added library currently requires a hand-written WorkerSourcePathMap prefix; matching configured library IDs can derive those mappings without changing the claim contract.
behavior_before: Workers only rewrote coordinator source paths through the manual WorkerSourcePathMap JSON prefix map.
behavior_after: Workers will fetch coordinator library roots, derive coordinator-root to local-root mappings by library ID, and merge manual WorkerSourcePathMap entries with precedence over automatic entries.
